commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: the witness's exemplar coupling, which round-2 evaluation showed unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 98 composition determined §301/§232/§338/§201/§122/Brazil action membership from five derived rules that tested equality against specific HTS statistical reporting numbers in other chapters (7202.11.10.00, 7601.10.30.00, 9506.62.40.40, 2203.00.00.30, 8541.42.00.10), provisions that can never describe a chapter 98 entry, so those branches had no basis in this chapter's cited source and were structurally dead (or, for `not entry_is_line_b`, structurally always on).
triage.triage_notes: Diff is exactly two hunks: the module summary (generator b1.3-schedule-compositions-1 -> b1.6-schedule-compositions-2, plus a new sentence declaring the five identifiers caller inputs) and the 100-line removal of the five derived rules; no consuming formula changed (verified pre/post: ieepa_component_rate, section_122_component_rate, section_201_component_rate, section_232_aluminum_component_rate, section_338_component_rate, china_section_301_component_rate, brazil_section_301_component_rate, forced_labor_section_301_component_rate, entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded, entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded, beer_section_232_aluminum_content_basis_duty_applies, section_338_reduced_duty_base_applies all still reference entry_is_line_*). Confirmed the defect is real rather than cosmetic by reading the imported line table us/policies/usitc/us-tariff-duty/lines/generated/ch98.yaml at this commit: it holds only 9801-98xx lines and contains none of the five exemplar numbers, so pre-fix every flag was constant false for any entry routed to this module. Doubt to flag for a reviewer: the module is module.kind: composition (generated/assembled, not encoder-authored), the commit body is empty, and the module summary still carries the boilerplate 'runtime semantics are unchanged' sentence even though the value source for five identifiers changed; the fix also does not itself encode the correct membership test, it defers it to entry preparation. Post-fix source_verification still lists the now-unused exemplar citation paths (7202.11.10.00, 7601.10.30.00, 9506.62.40.40, 2203.00.00.30, 8541.42.00.10). The §122 decoupling and section_232_steel_component_rate described in the PR body are NOT in this commit (grep of the post-fix file finds neither entry_is_section_122_exempt nor a steel component) — they land in later commits of PR #1300; a maintainer comment on that PR notes 'companion tests now feed only the retained exemplar flags (a/b/d) — c and e are fully replaced and no longer valid input slots'. resolve_provision was not run: the kind turns on which chapter the cited lines belong to, which the citation paths and the chapter line tables settle directly.
triage.verifier_justification: This commit's ch98 diff deletes only the five `entry_is_line_a..e` derived definitions and rewrites the summary; every consuming formula is byte-identical, so the module computes the same values for any given flag assignment and the change is purely a widening of the input surface (line/membership classification moves out to entry preparation), i.e. scope the pilot module never claimed rather than a corrected misstatement. The quote that justified the "untraceable_branch" call describes a repair that is not in this diff: after this commit `section_122_component_rate` still reads `if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0` (post line 2573); the exemplar coupling is only replaced two commits later in a9562cfd4 ("b1.6: generalize generated component surfaces"), which substitutes `if entry_is_section_122_exempt or entry_is_section_232_covered: 0`. The removed rules were also not untraceable in the citation sense — each carried a proof atom citing exactly the statistical reporting number it tested with a verbatim excerpt, and those citation paths remain in `source_verification` after the fix — and an identical cross-chapter exemplar coupling survives untouched in the post file (`entry_is_energy_resource` = `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"`, post line 1951), which a fidelity purge of chapter-foreign branches would have removed.
triage.verifier_quote: never through cross-chapter RuleSpec dispatch. The identifiers entry_is_line_a, entry_is_line_b, entry_is_line_c, entry_is_line_d, and entry_is_line_e are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation from incidence classification.
triage.verifier_notes: Evidence trail: diff /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maxghenis-TheAxiomFoundation-axiom-encode--claude-worktrees-zealous-heyrovsky-31a96b/86103d8f-b97f-4559-a96c-7e79bdbe616d/scratchpad/diffs/us/2a6bdb01de/096.diff (124 lines: one summary hunk + one deletion hunk, no formula hunks); pre/post copies at .../scratchpad/ch98_pre.yaml and .../scratchpad/ch98_post.yaml. (1) All 18 call sites of entry_is_line_* are unchanged pre->post (e.g. the §301 stack `if entry_is_line_a and origin_is_china: list_1_additional_ad_valorem_rate else: 0`, pre 3094 / post 2994). (2) The PR-body quote the first reader used belongs to a later commit: `git -C /Users/maxghenis/TheAxiomFoundation/rulespec-us show a9562cfd4 -- us/policies/cbp/us-tariff-schedule/generated/ch98/ch98.yaml` shows `-if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0` / `+if entry_is_section_122_exempt or entry_is_section_232_covered: 0`. If the corpus wants the real fidelity case from PR #1300, screen a9562cfd4 (and 198bee703 / a14f43975), not 2a6bdb01de. (3) The §232 steel component the PR describes is also absent from this commit's post file, confirming the semantic repairs are staged after this decoupling step. (4) Two things a reviewer may want to flag as separate, weaker issues in the post state: the module rationale still says the composition contributes "line selection over the five encoded HTS statistical reporting numbers" although that selection was just deleted (stale note, provenance-level), and the five identifiers now have no in-module definition or proof atoms while the five exemplar citation paths remain in source_verification. (5) The "structurally dead branch" premise in the first reader's reading is not established from the file: `hts_number` is an unconstrained caller input in this module (referenced, never defined), and nothing in ch98.yaml restricts it to chapter 98 values — only `hts_line` is pinned to the chapter by the `ch98_general_rate[hts_line]` lookup. If a reviewer disagrees with not_a_defect, the next-best verdict is unclear (input-surface change is meaning-bearing), not confirmed.
